pandas.Series.align

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Return two objects with compatible labels. Set join to choose which labels to retain.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.align(other, join='outer', axis=None, level=None, copy=…, fill_value=None)

Run the example

Edit the example and select Run Python to see the result.


    

    
Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
other
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      DataFrame or Series
Supply the second object or value used in the operation.


join
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'outer'		
      {'outer', 'inner', 'left', 'right'}
Select which labels to retain when bringing multiple axes into alignment.


axis
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      allowed axis of the other object
Choose which axis the operation acts on. The accepted axis labels depend on the receiver.


level
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      int or level name
Choose an index level by name or integer position.


copy
      Optional
Positional or keyword		
      bool
Control whether data is copied where the API supports that choice.

      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      scalar
Supply a value to use in place of a missing position.
